sheets.name: 00_CARTRIDGE_ARCH
values: ArbitrageX — Arquitectura objetivo para 264 cartuchos de estrategia
Cada .rhai descubre la condición económica propia de su estrategia; math-engine aporta operadores/evidencia; SizeOptimizer/simulación siguen siendo gates autoritativos.
Route/Event/External adapters → CartridgeContext full-route → pertinence router → cartucho evaluate_opportunity → StrategyCandidate → SizeOptimizer → simulation → net-profit/risk gates → opportunity.
op_01..op_31 viven en Rust. El cartucho referencia outputs; el generador Python no reimplementa SVD/Kalman/Kelly/Newton.
Ej.: |ln(Pb/Pa)| o Q_R(x)-x-costos es detector económico; op_01 sigue siendo SVD.
Todas las legs/rutas + snapshot de bloque + estado protocol-specific + quotes + dependencias. No sólo intent.legs.first().
RuntimeCartridgesTab ya es el punto de entrada. El formulario debe generarse desde config_schema/metadata del cartucho.
Eliminar hard cap global 8: derivar min/max del cartucho; la matriz fuente contiene estrategias de hasta 16 legs.
No ejecutar 264 cartuchos por cada swap. Filtrar por trigger, dependencia, protocolos, route shape, min/max legs y datos disponibles.
Missing quote/operator/oracle/settlement => is_opportunity=false + reason explícito; nunca defaults pseudo-matemáticos.
Spam, reorg/time-bandit, builder-integrated sin interfaz autorizada, points/pre-token y resolution timing no emiten hasta existir settlement determinístico.
01_MEV_MATRIX_1_11 = catálogo funcional; 02_CARTRIDGE_MATH_MAP = detector/operator/config; math-engine = implementación de operadores.
264 archivos con Universal Cartridge Contract (init_strategy/evaluate_opportunity/build_payload) y metadata machine-readable.
Candidate con detector_id, route, amount hints, mathematical evidence, reason y economic precheck; la validación final neta queda central.
CartridgeContextV3 + StrategyMathManifest v3; compatible con el runner de 3 funciones existente.
No arbitrary weights before PAPER/SHADOW calibration
Construir contexto con route_legs[] completo y snapshot común; no first leg only.
Añadir quote_route/quote_leg protocol-aware y get_operator_output/get_operator_scalar estables.
Convertir a generador de contrato/metadata/detector wiring; remover math duplicada y hardcoded pool_a/pool_b.
Migrar al contrato de 3 funciones y detector específico por MEV_ID/familia.
Reauditar operator lists contra detector family; separar primary/secondary y pesos calibrables.
Render dinámico de parámetros permitidos por config_schema; no fórmulas editables.
Quitar max(8) global y validar contra metadata por cartucho; soportar estrategia-specific params.
Aceptar StrategyCandidate emitido por cartucho y mantener SizeOptimizer/simulation/gates como autoridad.
LIVE_MAINNET is canonical. TESTNET and PAPER_SHADOW must reuse identical strategy/cartidge/math logic.
LIVE_MAINNET | TESTNET | PAPER_SHADOW. OFF/KILLSWITCH is control state, not economic mode.
Unified. Same meaning, same simulated ledger, same frontend-supplied simulation capital.
Actual transactions and actual settlement on the selected test network using testnet-network funds.
Actual mainnet state, real capital, real broadcast and real on-chain settlement.
Detector equations, applicable operators, operator phases, route rules, profitability equations and risk gates.
Network endpoints, asset addresses, capital source, broadcast adapter, settlement ledger.
Can set simulated capital in PAPER_SHADOW and permitted thresholds/constraints; cannot rewrite formulas/operators.
ARBX_ORCHESTRATOR_MODE / ARBX_CARTRIDGE_MODE may exist internally during migration but are not strategy semantics.
One hot path with a terminal execution/settlement adapter selected by canonical execution mode.

sheets.name: 08_CONFLICTS
values: SVD describes spectral structure; closed-route executable profit is the detector.
Promote Newton to primary sizing/root solver
Directly relevant to break-even/invariant/root solving after route discovery.
Optional graph pruning only; no runtime dependence until trained
Source is internally inconsistent and GNN must not be required absent trained artifact.
Do not let orphan heuristics override runtime/carttridge truth.
Delete duplicated operator math from generator
Detector equation and math operator are distinct contracts.
Reconcile per MEV_ID before code generation
Two source-of-truth surfaces are structurally allowed to diverge today.

sheets.name: 09_EXECUTION_MODES
values: ArbitrageX — Modelo canónico de ejecución: LIVE MAINNET como referencia
This is the canonical behavior all strategies are designed against.
Same cartridges, math, route logic and gates as LIVE; only chain/assets differ.
Same discovery/math/sizing/risk path; only terminal settlement and capital are simulated.
Not a trading mode. It disables execution/detection according to control policy.
A strategy's detector, equations, operator set, route constraints and gates MUST NOT change by mode.
The same MEV-XX-YYY .rhai cartridge is loaded in LIVE_MAINNET, TESTNET and PAPER_SHADOW.
op_01..op_31 implementation is identical in every mode.
Same adapters over selected market state
SizeOptimizer logic is identical; only available capital source changes.
Opportunity means the LIVE_MAINNET-economic condition is satisfied on the supplied state.
Mode changes only chain/asset environment, capital source, broadcast and settlement adapter.
There is one unified PAPER_SHADOW semantic mode; 'shadow' is not a second economic model.
Frontend may configure simulated capital and allowed strategy parameters, never detector equations or operator implementations.
Missing live/testnet state, quote, oracle, bridge or external feed => no opportunity; PAPER_SHADOW may not fabricate market inputs.
All acceptance criteria are specified first for LIVE_MAINNET; lower modes prove the same logic without changing it.

sheets.name: 10_MODE_MIGRATION
values: Execution-mode migration plan — single LIVE-first hot path
Always discover/evaluate identically; terminal adapter decides settlement
Cartridges always use same evaluation semantics when enabled
All operator roles invariant across modes
Golden vector parity across 3 modes until settlement boundary
